تبتذلي (form VIII)
# تَبْتَذِلِي (tabtaḏilī) /tab.ta.ði.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
# تُبْتَذَلِي (tubtaḏalī) /tub.ta.ða.liː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَذَلَ (ibtaḏala)
